from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyTaxInfo(BaseModel):
    """One company's tax payable information from a single financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as written in the report")
    securities_code: str | None = Field(description="The securities/stock code if provided")
    tax_payable_amount: float | None = Field(description="The '应交税费' amount value")
    amount_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount (e.g., '元', '百万元')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period")
    quote: str = Field(description="Brief excerpt from the report showing the tax amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_tax_infos: list[CompanyTaxInfo]
